core_loop: Drive the player tank through a single-screen 12x12 maze, fire bullets to break brick walls and kill enemy tanks, stay off hazard tiles, keep the HQ base alive, and drive onto the exit pad to clear the stage before moving on to the next, harder stage.

actions.name: Move
actions.desc: Drive the tank in the four cardinal directions; brick, steel and water tiles block movement, while floor, grass and goal tiles do not.

actions.name: Shoot
actions.desc: Fire a single bullet in the facing direction; bullets break brick tiles, destroy enemy tanks, are stopped by steel and only register when the stage has shooting enabled.

entities.desc: The player green tank; player input drives it, it can be destroyed by enemy bullets and it triggers the win when it reaches the exit pad.
Hostile tank that patrols open floor in stage three, fires bullets toward the player and the HQ base, and dies to a player bullet.
Fast small projectile fired by the player or an enemy tank; destroys brick tiles and kills tanks, but is stopped by steel.
Transient visual effect entity spawned where a bullet hits a tank, the HQ base or a brick tile; purely cosmetic and never blocks movement.
The eagle HQ base prop present on every stage; it blocks nothing, but its destruction by an enemy bullet immediately loses the stage.
Small tank life icon in the HUD showing how many player tanks remain.
HUD text strip showing the current stage number and the stage objective.

rules.statement: The player tank moves one tile step per input on tiles whose semantics are not blocking (floor f, grass t, goal pad g); brick b, steel x and water w stop it.
Pressing shoot spawns one bullet at the tank facing edge travelling in that direction; a tank may have at most one live bullet.
A bullet impact on a brick tile b destroys that brick tile, removes the bullet and spawns an explosion; brick tiles are the only destructible wall type.
Steel tiles x stop both tanks and bullets; a bullet hitting steel is removed with a small explosion and the steel tile survives.
Water tiles w are impassable for the player tank and for enemy tanks but do not stop bullets.
Standing on a hazard tile h destroys the player tank and loses the stage immediately.
Each enemy tank patrols open floor along its facing direction, turns when blocked, and periodically fires a bullet toward the base or the player.
A bullet hitting the player tank destroys the player tank and loses the stage; a bullet hitting an enemy tank destroys the enemy tank and spawns an explosion.
The HQ base occupies one floor tile per stage; an enemy bullet reaching it destroys the base and loses the stage, so the player must clear the approach lanes.
Stepping onto a goal pad tile g completes the stage; every stage exit is reachable from the spawn tile by walking only on non-blocking tiles.
Stage one spawns no enemies and no hazards, stage two adds firing at brick walls, stage three adds enemy tanks, water and steel cover.

win_condition.statement: The player tank steps onto the stage exit pad tile g.

lose_condition.statement: The stage is lost when the player tank is hit by a bullet, stands on a hazard tile, or the HQ base is destroyed.
